# Escala colour roles (Categorical)

83 roles in 6 groups. Every role ships as:

- **CSS** `--color-<group>-<key>` with dots turned into dashes (`action.primary.hover` → `--color-action-primary-hover`).
- **Figma** collection `Color Semantics`, variable `<Group>/<key path>` (`Action/primary/hover`), one mode per theme (Light, Dark, a brand…).
- **Recipes / tokens.json** `color.<group>.<key>` and `colors.architecture.tokens.<group>.<key>`.

`Light` / `Dark` are the schema refs BEFORE a theme resolves them. A plain `{family.N}` is a pinned step of that family's 12-step ramp. Anything else is SOLVED per theme (see the marker legend at the end) — the hex moves with the brand, so never copy a hex from one system into another.

## Border — `border.*`

Strokes: decoration, control boundary, focus.

| Role | CSS | Figma | Light | Dark | Tone | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border.default` | `--color-border-default` | `Border/default` | `{black-a.3}` | `{white-a.3}` | pinned | **Decorative Border 2/3.** Affects a card edge, a panel boundary, a grouping box. {black-a.3} / {white-a.3}. DECORATION, no contrast floor. One step above border.subtle so a panel edge still outranks a hairline. |
| `border.subtle` | `--color-border-subtle` | `Border/subtle` | `{black-a.2}` | `{white-a.2}` | pinned | **Decorative Border 1/3.** Affects hairline dividers, table rules, the edge of a quiet grouping. Lightest neutral stroke — {black-a.2} in light, {white-a.2} in dark (the FIXED alpha ladder, so it composites correctly on any surface). One step above the 5% rung: that step measured APCA Lc 0 on the dark page. DECORATION: separates regions, carries no state, no contrast floor. If the stroke is the only thing telling the user a control is there, that is border.control. |
| `border.control` | `--color-border-control` | `Border/control` | `{ctl-a:black-a.3}` | `{ctl-a:white-a.3}` | solved | **Control Boundary.** Affects the resting border of inputs, textareas, selects, checkboxes, radios, switch tracks and outline buttons. SOLVED on the alpha ladder ({ctl-a:…}) to the WCAG 1.4.11 control boundary (3:1) against the page: {black-a.7} in Light, {white-a.6} in Dark for the default system, so a field reads without a fill. |
| `border.control-hover` | `--color-border-control-hover` | `Border/control-hover` | `{ctl+a:black-a.3}` | `{ctl+a:white-a.3}` | solved | **Control Boundary Hover.** Affects the hover state of a control's resting (border.control) border. One step past whatever border.control RESOLVED to ({ctl+a:…}), never a fixed step — pinning it would collapse it onto rest. {black-a.8} / {white-a.7} for the default system. |
| `border.strong` | `--color-border-strong` | `Border/strong` | `{ui-a:black-a.5}` | `{ui-a:white-a.5}` | solved | **Strong Border.** Affects the edge of a grouping or a selected container that must read before its neighbours. Not the field outline — that is border.control. WCAG 1.4.11 + APCA Lc 45 against the page, SOLVED on the alpha ladder ({ui-a:…}): {black-a.7} in light, {white-a.8} in dark for the default system. |
| `border.accent` | `--color-border-accent` | `Border/accent` | `{accent.8}` | `{accent.8}` | pinned | **Accent Border.** Border painted in the brand accent — a selected card, a toggled button, any element that needs its stroke to read as the primary accent. For keyboard focus use border.focus. |
| `border.focus` | `--color-border-focus` | `Border/focus` | `{focus:accent.9}` | `{focus:accent.9}` | solved | **A11y Focus Ring.** The keyboard focus-visible boundary on every interactive element of the default / accent variant. SOLVED per theme ({focus:accent.9}): the first accent tone from 9 that clears WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on the page — tone 9 in both themes for the default system. Severity, neutral and inverse variants take their own boundary (status.<sev>.border-strong, border.strong, border.inverse). The translucent halo outside it is border.ring.*. |
| `border.ring.default` | `--color-border-ring-default` | `Border/ring/default` | `{accent-a.6}` | `{accent-a.6}` | pinned | **Focus Halo.** Translucent glow outside border.focus. Paired with border.focus on EVERY focused control (shadcn border-ring + ring-[3px]): the edge turns to border.focus, this halo sits outside it. Never the only focus cue. Decoration, NOT a boundary — never measured for WCAG 1.4.11; border.focus is the contrast-bearing part. Replaces a hardcoded 40% alpha in the preview specimens. A field in an error/success state reuses status.<sev>.border for its halo — there is no separate per-severity ring role. |
| `border.rim-highlight` | `--color-border-rim-highlight` | `Border/rim-highlight` | `{white-a.1}` | `{white-a.1}` | pinned | **Elevation Rim.** 1px light rim along the top of an elevated surface in dark mode. Below a near-black page only ~5% of the luminance range is left to spend downward, so elevation has to be bought with light, not shadow — this is the token for the rim darkShadow() already paints. |
| `border.inverse` | `--color-border-inverse` | `Border/inverse` | `{white-a.5}` | `{black-a.5}` | pinned | **Inverse Border.** Any stroke ON surface.inverse — an outline badge, a divider in a tooltip, a group edge. {white-a.5} in Light, {black-a.5} in Dark. Decoration: no 1.4.11 floor, never the only boundary of a control. |

## elevation — `elevation.*`



| Role | CSS | Figma | Light | Dark | Tone | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elevation.shadow-key` | `--color-elevation-shadow-key` | `Elevation/shadow-key` | `{black-a.2}` | `{black-a.6}` | pinned | **Shadow Key.** The main, larger-offset layer of every Shadow/* and Depth/* recipe. EFFECT colour only, never a fill or stroke. {black-a.2} (10%) in Light, {black-a.6} (40%) in Dark, so one shadow style follows the theme. |
| `elevation.shadow-ambient` | `--color-elevation-shadow-ambient` | `Elevation/shadow-ambient` | `{black-a.1}` | `{black-a.4}` | pinned | **Shadow Ambient.** The tight, secondary layer of the shadow and depth recipes. EFFECT colour only. {black-a.1} (5%) in Light, {black-a.4} (20%) in Dark. |
| `elevation.shadow-ring` | `--color-elevation-shadow-ring` | `Elevation/shadow-ring` | `{white-a.1}` | `{white-a.1}` | pinned | **Shadow Ring.** The 0 0 0 1px highlight edge every shadow and depth recipe starts with. EFFECT colour only. {white-a.1} in both themes: invisible on a light surface, the rim that buys elevation on a dark page. |
| `elevation.highlight` | `--color-elevation-highlight` | `Elevation/highlight` | `{white-a.3}` | `{white-a.3}` | pinned | **Solid Control Highlight.** The inner 2px top highlight of a solid filled control (primary and destructive buttons, every state but disabled): box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 var(--color-elevation-highlight). {white-a.3} in both themes. EFFECT colour only. |

## Marker legend

| Marker | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `{fam.N}` | Step N of the family ramp (1 = page end, 12 = high-contrast text end, 9 = the brand hex itself). Same step means the same job in Light and Dark. `{neutral-light.1}` is the LIGHT page, reachable from a dark theme (the light ink of a solid that stays light-inked in Dark). |
| `{fam-a.N}` | Alpha twin of step N, solved against the page so it reproduces the solid there. Translucent: composites on any surface. |
| `{black-a.N}` / `{white-a.N}` | Fixed Radix alpha ladder (5 … 95 %). Darkens / lightens an unknown backdrop. |
| `{fam.solid}` | The fill, by job: Light step 09 with the light ink; Dark accent 10, critical 08 (light ink), success 09, warning / info 10 (dark ink) — kept while the pair clears WCAG AA, else the tone nearest the anchor that carries a label. |
| `{on:fam.solid}` | The ink that fill was solved with: the light page or the dark page. Never assume white. |
| `{step:fam+N}` | N steps AWAY from the ink (hover +1, pressed +2): darker under a light ink, lighter under a dark one. |
| `{ui:fam.N}` / `{ui+:fam.N}` | Walks from step N until WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) + APCA Lc 45 clear; `+` is one step past it. |
| `{ui-a:…}` | The same 3:1 + Lc 45 walk on the black/white alpha ladder (border.strong). |
| `{ctl-a:…}` / `{ctl+a:…}` | Control boundary on the alpha ladder: the first step clearing WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on the page; `+` is its hover. |
| `{focus:fam.N}` | The focus boundary: the first step from N clearing WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on the page. |
| `{ink:fam.N}` | The tone of that family legible as text on its own tint at step N. |
| `{link:fam.N}` / `{link+:fam.N}` | Link ink solved against page, layer-1 and layer-2 from step N; `+` is its hover. |
| `{dis:fam.N}` | Disabled ink: walks from N to the disabled-text floor, never reaching body contrast. |
